authored_not_manufacturer_verified.lower_arm_recesses: Three front-face blind recesses; centers z=390,650,910 mm and radii 45 x 79 mm. A 75 mm nominal wall and separate backing casting give about 44–48 mm visible cavity depth. All sizes and blind termination are visual estimates.
authored_not_manufacturer_verified.casting_profiles: All arm section widths, sweeps, bevels, pin/cap/fastener sizes, pedestal opening contours, side-positioned service enclosure and service panels are estimates.
authored_not_manufacturer_verified.pedestal_footprint_note: Inherited overall envelope retained. Previously cited global catalog is excluded because of its reproduction clause. An official Europe datasheet search excerpt corroborates the numbers but the full document could not be inspected in this refinement; these dimensions are not newly manufacturer-verified here.
authored_not_manufacturer_verified.joint_range_split: J2 -44..100 and J3 -126..10 degrees are inherited fits to published operating-envelope endpoints; only spans are manufacturer-published. Real coupled interference restrictions are not represented.
authored_not_manufacturer_verified.flange: Existing approximate plain faceplate retained. No verified bolt/hole pattern, hollow-bore dimension, ISO mounting claim, calibration or dynamics. No new mounting holes invented.

excluded_sources: The global RM-410iC(E)-05 catalog has an explicit reproduction prohibition; it was not used as a new authoring/dimension source. No manuals or vendor meshes were used.
compatibility: All 14 links, 13 joints, commanded axes, mimic rules, frames, limits and velocities are unchanged from main 5a715e3. 2026-10-10: the deliberately narrowed primitive collisions were replaced by boxes, axis cylinders and slabs around the drawn parts; every link visual now lies inside its collision.
